verdict.rationale: Linear's own docs point agents to an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.linear.app/mcp for reading and changing issues and projects. A probe also confirms a dedicated MCP docs page at linear.app/docs/mcp. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of the MCP tool set, auth flow and client setup in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: For agents: connect to the Linear MCP server at https://mcp.linear.app/mcp to read and change issues, projects
official MCP server documented at https://linear.app/docs/mcp
